title: Unified Live H1 Root
objective: Compile the resident generated class candidate and live h1 owner bridge in one source-transparent native call graph with transactional exact-h1 publication

handoff.summary: Adds one source-transparent native root that runs the 351-parameter resident generated candidate and the live H1 owner bridge in one compiled call graph. Large candidate owners pass directly, the sole type mismatch is an explicit eight-word preparation-state repack, and the root exposes live suffix dimensions/counts while keeping public completion false.
risks: This is an exact-H1 prefix only; exact unit expansion and precision authority remain downstream.
The focused checker uses the existing resident sanitizer to allocate prepared input owners outside the computation.
next_steps: Feed the live bridge outputs and exposed counts into a non-answer-derived precision retry/convergence suffix.
Set public completion only after the exact-unit suffix independently succeeds.
